description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different video types, divided into twelve distinct categories, each represented by a colored slice with its corresponding percentage value labeled inside. The largest segment is “People Blogs” at 17.2%, followed by “Entertainment” at 13.9%, and “Howto Style” at 9.7%. Other categories include “Education” (8.7%), “Music” (2.3%), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%), “Pets Animals” (3.9%), “News Politics” (4.3%), “Science Technology” (6.4%), “Comedy” (5.6%), “Travel Events” (4.6%), “Gaming” (6.4%), and “Film Animation” (4.6%). The chart is labeled with a legend that matches each category to its color, and the percentages are clearly displayed within each slice, allowing for direct comparison of the relative proportions of each video type in the dataset. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top right with “People Blogs”.
